scenario: `then` requires a `ts` slot on every schema in the sequence per LTHE.4.5. The anchor schema missing `ts` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_WITHIN_NO_TS_SLOT naming the anchor schema. Pin: `Door` (no ts) then `Motion` (has ts) → error naming Door.
rules_ds:
schema Door scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

rule entry:
    Door
    then Motion within 30_s
->
    log info "entry"
